params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$dirs=@((Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner-heaven'),(Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner-heaven-v2'))
Write-Output '=== LISTENERS ==='
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Runner.Listener.exe' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
foreach($d in $dirs){ Write-Output ('=== DIR '+$d+' ==='); Write-Output ('exists='+(Test-Path $d)); Write-Output ('runner='+(Test-Path (Join-Path $d '.runner'))); Write-Output ('run.cmd='+(Test-Path (Join-Path $d 'run.cmd'))); if(Test-Path (Join-Path $d '.runner')){ $j=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d '.runner') | ConvertFrom-Json; [pscustomobject]@{agentId=$j.agentId;agentName=$j.agentName;poolId=$j.poolId;serverUrl=$j.serverUrl} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } }
Write-Output '=== TASKS ==='
Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -like 'GitHub Actions Runner*' } | Select-Object TaskName,State,@{n='RunLevel';e={$_.Principal.RunLevel}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
Write-Output '=== STARTUP ==='
Get-ChildItem ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*HeavenGitHubActionsRunner*' } | Select-Object Name,FullName | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
